name: Arisuno Ruiji
source: A rookie teacher who works at Hoshirai Academy and father to Alice, who was created by what he calls talent. He was driven out of his apartment because of her and is now staying at the school's dinner room. Ruiji is usually getting pushed around by Kokoro, hospitalized due to Alice, assaulted by Teru and teased by Umi.
